args.description: 读取 privacy-masking skill 的 SKILL.md 文件
执行 privacy-masking 真链路测试命令
args.command:
mkdir -p /mnt/user-data/outputs/privacy-masking /mnt/user-data/workspace/privacy-masking
python /mnt/skills/custom/ffmpeg-utils/scripts/run.py --operation keyframe --input-path /mnt/datasets/Vedio-demo/Trafic.mp4 --timestamp 1 --output-path /mnt/user-data/workspace/privacy-masking/source.jpg --output /mnt/user-data/workspace/privacy-masking/keyframe_result.json
python - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
regions = {"sensitive_regions":[{"type":"face","bbox":[20,20,180,160]}]}
p = pathlib.Path('/mnt/user-data/workspace/privacy-masking/regions.json')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
json.dump(regions, p.open('w'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
PY
python /mnt/skills/custom/privacy-masking/scripts/run.py --image-uri /mnt/user-data/workspace/privacy-masking/source.jpg --sensitive-regions-json /mnt/user-data/workspace/privacy-masking/regions.json --method gaussian_blur --config /mnt/skills/custom/configs/deerflow_config.json --output /mnt/user-data/outputs/privacy-masking/result.json

args.description: 重新执行完整的 privacy-masking 测试命令

python /mnt/skills/custom/privacy-masking/scripts/run.py --image-uri /mnt/user-data/workspace/privacy-masking/source.jpg --sensitive-regions-json /mnt/user-data/workspace/privacy-masking/regions.json --method gaussian_blur --config /mnt/skills/custom/configs/deerflow_config.json --output /mnt/user-data/outputs/privacy-masking/result.json
